application.name: @gftdcojp/spirit-in-physics
application.description: Jung's Word Association Test Embedding Model for quantifying the human spirit.

processes.name: Data Collection (2 Sessions)
processes.description: Core process where the user performs the word association test. Webcam and microphone are recorded continuously for each session. To ensure data integrity against interruptions, the video recording is periodically saved by overwriting the session file.
steps: User starts a session, granting camera/mic permissions.
A continuous webcam and microphone recording begins.
Every 10 seconds, the recording up to that point is saved as a complete, playable video file, overwriting the previous save.
A stimulus word audio is played, followed by a fixed 6-second response window.
This loop repeats for all words.
At the end of the session, the final recording is saved.

processes.name: Live Event Logging
processes.description: Throughout each session, every significant event is immediately written to a session-specific log file, ensuring data integrity and supporting session resumption.

components.name: JungVoiceTest
components.description: Handles the entire data collection flow. Manages the MediaRecorder for continuous recording and uses a timer to periodically send the full recording data to the server for overwrite-saving.

components.name: kawasakiStore
components.description: Zustand store that manages the session state and orchestrates data saving operations. It receives blobs from the component and forwards them to the server-side API.

components.name: saveArtifactApi
components.description: Server-side API route that receives data from the client (video blobs, log files) and writes them directly to the `artifacts/sessions` directory, overwriting files with the same name.

dataFlows.flow: Full Experiment Execution with Incremental Overwrite

steps.action: Continuous webcam and mic recording for Session 1 starts.
Dispatches 'logEvent' for 'session_start'. Log file is saved/updated via API.
(Loop) Stimulus audio plays. 'word_displayed' is logged and saved.

(Background Loop) Every 10 seconds, a complete, playable .webm blob of the recording so far is created and sent to the `/api/save-artifact` endpoint, overwriting the previous version of `session-1-video.webm`.
When Session 1 ends, the continuous recording is stopped, triggering a final save of the video file.
User starts Session 2, repeating the same recording and logging process for `session-2-video.webm` and `session-2-log.json`.
